description: This file defines the CustomerService interface, specifying methods for customer management such as retrieving customers by name, nickname, store, and address, as well as saving or updating customer data.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Interface defining customer-related operations such as retrieval, listing, and updating customer data.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided first name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer or updates an existing customer's data.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers by store with specified search criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname and store ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns a customer's address based on store and IP address, using a geolocation module.
